title: Hole Escape Puzzle
description:
Welcome to Hole Escape Puzzle! Get ready for a super fun and addictive game where smart strategy is key. Your mission: guide colorful stickmen to their perfectly matched holes! It sounds simple, but with tricky pathways, limited space, and new obstacles, you'll need some clever thinking to succeed!

🎮 How to Play:
- Clear the Route: Strategically move platforms and rows to create a clear path for your stickmen to reach their designated holes.
- Call the Helicopter: Discover special ways to guide certain stickmen directly into waiting Helicopters. This adds an exciting new layer to your sorting strategy!
- Manage Your Slots: Empty out the front areas and cleverly use your available slots to funnel all the stickmen to their destinations successfully.
- Color Coordination: Watch out! Stickmen of different colors will block each other's way. Plan your moves wisely to avoid jams and make sure everyone gets to their correct color-coded hole.
- Think Ahead: Your ultimate goal is to fill all the stickmen into their holes before your slots become full. One wrong move can lead to a fun, but challenging, restart!

🌟 Key Features:
- No Timer! Enjoy a stress-free experience. Take your time to strategize and make the perfect move without any pressure.
- Simple, Strategic, & Fun: Easy to learn mechanics, but with deep strategic layers that will keep you engaged for hours.
- Brain-Teasing Puzzles: Challenge your logic and planning skills through a variety of clever levels.
- Intuitive Controls: Smooth and responsive gameplay ensures a satisfying puzzle experience.
- Unique Helicopter Mechanic: Experience a fresh twist as you master beaming stickmen into their airborne transport!
- Free to Play: Download and jump into the fun right away, with no upfront costs.

🧠 Why You'll Love Hole Escape Puzzle:
Sort passengers to their matching holes and beam them into their designated Helicopters in this fun and brain-teasing puzzle game. It’s your job to make sure all stickmen reach their correct destination, all while managing your available space and dealing with new arrivals. Are you up for the challenge?

Download Hole Escape Puzzle today and embark on your strategic sorting adventure – on the ground and in the air!
